memory_annotations.evidence_summary: For the Phoenix opening review, Marcus accepted the Monday evening American nonstop and asked to retain two Wednesday nonstop returns pending confirmation of whether the final meeting ends at 4:00 or 5:15. The earlier return is viable only with an immediate 4:00 departure from Chandler; the later return accommodates the possible added meeting.

messages.content: I need flights for a restaurant opening review in suburban Phoenix. The walkthrough starts at 9:00 Tuesday, March 10, and I expect to finish around 4:00 Wednesday, March 11. I’ll leave from Chicago.
To make the Tuesday start dependable, I’d look at Monday evening nonstop flights from ORD to PHX. Before I compare returns, will you have a rental car, and where in the Phoenix area is the review?
The site is in Chandler near Loop 202 and Arizona Avenue. I’ll rent a car at the airport. One traveler, round trip, economy.
Understood. A Monday arrival also leaves room for the rental-car pickup and the drive to Chandler. Are you comfortable landing around 10:00 p.m., or should I keep the arrival earlier?
Around 10 is fine. I don’t need extra time Monday beyond getting to the hotel.

The strongest outbound is American 2887, nonstop from ORD at 7:05 p.m. Monday and arriving PHX at 9:18 p.m. local time. It is $418 round trip when paired with the earlier Wednesday return. Allow about 35 to 50 minutes for the rental-car center and another 25 to 35 minutes to Chandler, putting you at the hotel around 10:25 to 10:45 p.m.
That outbound works. What are the Wednesday choices? The local team thinks 4:00 is the end time, but they haven’t ruled out another meeting.

Two nonstop returns are worth carrying forward. American 1812 leaves PHX at 6:25 p.m. and reaches ORD at 11:52 p.m.; the round trip is $418. United 2274 leaves at 8:45 p.m. and arrives ORD at 2:08 a.m. Thursday; combining separate airlines brings the total to $463.
Is 6:25 actually realistic if we finish at 4? Include the drive and rental return, not just flight time.

It is possible but tight. From Chandler, a 4:00 p.m. departure would typically reach the PHX rental-car center around 4:30 to 4:50. Returning the car and taking the train to the terminal could put you at security around 5:00 to 5:20, leaving roughly 65 to 85 minutes before departure. A traffic delay or meeting overrun would erode that quickly.
What if the added meeting runs until 5:15?

Then the 6:25 flight is not workable. Leaving at 5:15 would likely put you at the rental-car center between 5:50 and 6:10, already too late once the return process and terminal transfer are included. The 8:45 flight is practical: aim to leave by 5:45, reach the rental center around 6:20, and be in the terminal around 6:45 to 7:05.
Keep the Monday American outbound and both returns in play. I’ll decide after the team confirms whether Wednesday ends at 4 or 5:15. Give me the decision rule.

Carry these forward: American 2887 Monday, ORD 7:05 p.m. to PHX 9:18 p.m.; American 1812 Wednesday, PHX 6:25 p.m. to ORD 11:52 p.m.; and United 2274 Wednesday, PHX 8:45 p.m. to ORD 2:08 a.m. Thursday. Choose the 6:25 return only if the team confirms a firm 4:00 finish and you can leave the Chandler site immediately. If the meeting may run later, use the 8:45 return. No flight has been booked.
